plain_statement: For each of the 85 graphs listed in the term: every graph with no 4-cycle, no isolated vertex and at most 7 vertices whose exhaustive searches finished in both models (one per isomorphism class), the function true exactly when both ends of some edge are true has a circuit of AND, OR and NOT gates of fan-in two with at most s gates, s the number written beside it (edges plus vertex cover number minus one). Every gate counted, inputs not.
title: Edge functions of 85 small graphs with no 4-cycle: circuits of AND, OR and NOT of fan-in two with edges + cover - 1 gates
